title: 第742章 虞姬不见了第741章 幽冥相见
content_zh:
幽冥界。
虚空中。
文殊菩萨看向陆生，双手合十道：
“贫僧见过陆天尊！”
见文殊主动跟自己打招呼。
陆生嘴角微微上扬，眉头轻挑：
“文殊。”
“见到本天尊来了，你还不逃？”
“你真以为，本天尊会给弥勒面子，放你一马？”
听到陆生的话。
文殊摇头，客气道：
“天尊说笑了。”
“佛门与天庭之间虽有些小误会。”
“但以陆天尊的身份，自然不会与小僧计较。”
见文殊主动放低姿态。
陆生摇了摇头：
“你倒是个机灵人。”
“比弥勒那个呆子聪明多了。”
“一句话，便将本天尊的杀意打消了。”
说到这里。

陆生语气一顿，看向文殊：
“文殊。”
“你可以回去了。”
“这里的事情，你掺合不了。”
文殊闻言，心中一沉：
“天尊这话是何意？”
一旁的二师姐，撇嘴道：
“道主让你滚。”
“你没听到吗？”
听到二师姐的话。
文殊眉头一皱，看向二师姐：
“道友也是我们这个层次的强者。”
“说话为何如此粗鄙？”
听到文殊的话。
二师姐点了点头，淡淡道：
“与你身处一个层次，确实是个耻辱！”
“你这种小人，也能成为佛门菩萨。”
content_en:
The underworld.
In the void.
Manjushri Bodhisattva looked at Lu Sheng, put his hands together and said:
"The poor monk has seen Lu Tianzun!"
Seeing Manjusri take the initiative to say hello to him.
The corners of Lu Sheng's mouth raised slightly and his brows raised slightly:
"Manjushri."
"You see me coming, why don't you run away?"
"Do you really think that this Heavenly Lord will give Maitreya face and let you go?"
Hear what Lu Sheng said.
Manjusri shook his head and said politely:
"Tianzun is joking."
"Although there is a small misunderstanding between Buddhism and Heaven."
"But with Lu Tianzun's status, he will naturally not argue with the young monk."
Seeing Manjusri take the initiative to lower his posture.
Lu Sheng shook his head:
"You are quite a clever man."
"Much smarter than that idiot Miroku."
"One sentence will dispel my murderous intention."
Speaking of which.
Lu Sheng paused and looked at Manjusri:
"Manjushri."
"You can go back."
"You can't interfere with things here."
When Manjusri heard this, his heart sank:
"What does Tianzun mean by this?"
The second senior sister on the side curled her lips and said:
"The Taoist Master tells you to get out."
"Didn't you hear that?"
Hear what Second Senior Sister said.
Manjusri frowned and looked at Second Senior Sister:
"Fellow Taoist is also a strong man at our level."
"Why do you speak so vulgarly?"
Hear the words of Manjusri.
Second Senior Sister nodded and said calmly:
"It's really a shame to be on the same level as you!"
"A villain like you can also become a Buddhist Bodhisattva."
